meta_title: opentcy · Your agency's content team, inside your agent
meta_description: Open source skill and MCP server that turn your agent into an art director, designer and copywriter. Interactive brief, campaigns with images and copy, and pixel-level quality control. Runs locally.
hero_lead: opentcy is a skill and an MCP server that turn Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client into an art director, designer and copywriter. It runs on your machine; brands and pieces are files you own.
hero_note: No SaaS. No account. No download limits.
brief_lead: What you want to convey, goal, audience, offer, tone, channels and dates. It builds the brief from that; only then does it compose.
demo_user_request: I need a campaign for the winter blend launch.
demo_q_message: Before I design: what do you want to convey?
demo_q_audience: Who are we talking to, and on which channels?
demo_a_audience: People who brew coffee at home. Instagram and LinkedIn.
demo_q_facts: Which facts can I state? I don't make up figures or prices.
demo_a_facts: We roast on Mondays. Ships in 48 h.
demo_result: Done. A 6-slide 4:5 carousel, captions and alt text.
flow_title: From the brief to a file ready to publish.
flow_lead: Six steps, all inside your repository. The agent does the work; you decide what ships.
flow_1_body: The agent asks what you want to convey, goal, audience, offer, tone, channels and dates before touching a slide.
flow_2_body: Imports colors, typefaces, logo and voice from a website. Seven color roles, three families and verified facts with a source.
flow_3_body: Carousels, posts and stories in 4:5, 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Captions per network, alt text, a PDF for LinkedIn and MP4 video.
flow_4_body: Your photos first; then stock from Pexels, Unsplash and Openverse with credit and license recorded, focal point and protected regions.
flow_5_body: Measured on the render: contrast, safe zones, widows, crops that cut faces, unsourced figures and phrases that sound like AI.
flow_6_body: A subagent reviews it cold and every change is versioned. You approve: the agent never publishes on its own.
quality_title: It measures the render, not the intent.
quality_lead: Every piece is rendered with Chrome and checked pixel by pixel. Passing checks is not aesthetic approval, which is why a cold review follows.
mcp_title: The same tools, in any client.
mcp_lead: The skill teaches the agent the craft; the MCP gives it hands. It runs over stdio, with no server to maintain.
install_lead: Install the skill, create the workspace and connect the MCP. You need Node and Chrome.
install_skill_note: Adds the skill to your agent.
install_workspace_note: Creates the working folder with a sample brand.
install_mcp_note: In Claude Code. For other clients, paste this block into their configuration:
why_title: Built for agencies, not for a dashboard.
why_1_body: MIT license. Read the code, change it, send a PR.
why_2_body: Runs on your machine with your agent. No account, no third-party server.
why_3_body: HTML and CSS per slide, versionable in git. Nothing is locked in.
why_4_body: Checks run on the rendered image, not on a promise.
why_5_body: One folder per brand, with its kit, voice and history, from day one.
cta_title: Your next campaign, in your repository.
cta_lead: Install it in a minute and ask for the first piece.
footer_tagline: Open source skill and MCP for content teams.
